projects.title: Projects
projects.lede: Selected projects that demonstrate ownership, technical reasoning, architecture decisions, and proof of work.
projects.screensNote: Captures of the production app, with a fictitious household created only for this demo: names, accounts and amounts are invented, and no real data appears here.

xp.legendLead: Each project gets a base from its level, with a written criterion, and +5 for each piece of evidence the page itself proves. The bands do not overlap: evidence ranks projects within a level, never past the next one. It is a self-assessment with public criteria, not a certification.

criteria.foundational: Study or practice with a guided scope, one concept at a time
criteria.applied: A complete tool or product, used for real, built on known patterns
criteria.advanced: A system in production with real users or data, and at least one hard decision in architecture, security or scale
criteria.frontier: A foundation other systems consume, or a problem with no ready recipe, that sets the patterns others follow

proofs.production: A link to the live product, or a section of the page that describes real use
proofs.public-code: A link to the public repository
proofs.decision-records: A link to the public ADRs
proofs.screens: At least one screen in the gallery

design.title: Visual standard
design.description: The FelpsXP visual standard, live: colours, type, icons, components and the variations still being chosen, side by side, in both themes.
design.lead: The FelpsXP visual standard, live, built with the same components the pages use. Its base is Primer, GitHub's open-source design system, with a few discreet retro touches as a signature.

colors.title: Colour
colors.lead: The same tokens in both themes. A state tone appears as a border or a muted fill, never as a saturated background behind text.

type.title: Type
type.lead: System faces for everything people read. The two retro faces only mark: never the name, headings, running text or numbers.
type.body: Running text at 16 px, with a line height that is comfortable for unhurried reading.
type.typewriterFace: Special Elite: small labels above sections
type.pixelFace: Press Start 2P: only the XP badge and the FelpsXP mark

icons.title: Icons
icons.lead: Octicons, 16 px beside headings and navigation and 12 px in meta lines, always next to a text label.

components.title: Components
components.boxRow1: Rows divided by the border colour, for lists inside a Box
components.boxRow2: Each row can carry an icon, text and badges
components.boxRow3: The header row sits on the surface fill
components.scoreDetail: Unit tests, in the latest build
